thread:
sarah (sec eng): Heads up — we're rolling a schema update for audit events that affects key rotation and RBAC admin actions. Need docs, a customer sample pack, and a validation checklist. Plan: push schema to staging Tue, GA in ~2 weeks. Who can own customer comms?
ajay (product): I can draft the customer-facing note. quick question — is this breaking for integrations?
luis (eng): short answer: potentially for anyone parsing exact field names. main changes: rename "actor" -> "user", add "auth_method" (values: password, sso, kms), and add "kms_key_id" for KMS ops. we'll emit an "X-Audit-Deprecation" header and keep "actor" as an alias for 2 weeks.
mike (docs): I'll add a changelog entry + sample jsons. can you paste canonical sample events we should ship?
sarah (sec eng): sample event (canonical):
```json
{
  "timestamp": "2026-03-15T14:02:11Z",
  "event_type": "key_rotation",
  "user": { "id": "u_123", "email": "eng+deploy@redwood.ai" },
  "auth_method": "kms",
  "kms_key_id": "projects/prod/keys/rdw-001",
  "resource": "model-serving/gpu-pool-3",
  "meta": { "reason": "automatic rotation", "correlation_id": "c-987" }
}
```
devsec-bot: schema-validator: new schema v3 pushed to staging at 1842019015, tests: 18/20 passing — failures are optional-field parsing on two legacy adopters.
natalie (acct mgr): I'll compile the list of Dedicated/Private customers likely impacted and flag enterprise legal teams. ETA EOD.
ajay (product): For the customer note I propose a short lead: "No action for most customers. If you parse audit JSON directly, update parsers by Apr 1. New fields improve KMS and RBAC visibility." I'll post a draft in #announcements once we have samples + changelog.
luis (eng): extra detail on RBAC: when role mappings are changed via API or Console we now emit "privilege_escalation" events with before/after role snapshots. Ensure our retention and indexers include these for 90 days. Also confirm KMS events include key identifiers and operation type (rotate, disable).
sarah (sec eng): Action list: mike -> docs + sample pack and migration snippet; ajay -> draft external comms; natalie -> customer list + prioritization; luis -> implement alias + tests + ensure retention; sec -> sign off on the validation runbook (I will). I'll open the PRs and a short support runbook for quick verification.
mike (docs): :thumbsup: I'll have the changelog, sample pack, and a quick migration snippet by tomorrow noon. sample pack will include both older "actor" alias and new fields.
ajay (product): once draft ready @sarah please sanity check legal wording. also cc @support-ops for runbook.
support-ops: Quick grep users can run to find these events while triaging: `jq -c 'select(.event_type=="privilege_escalation" or .auth_method=="kms")' /var/log/redwood/audit/*.json` — will add to runbook.
sarah (sec eng): thanks everyone. final timeline: staging schema Tue, small beta with 2 customers Wed, GA Apr 1. I'll spin up a thread in #customer-success and ping the flagged accounts. If anyone wants to pair on the validation harness let me know.
